children: Tokenized stock TVL on Uniswap V4 has reached $59.1 million, ranking first among DeFi protocols in the category. According to Odaily, Kamino Lend and Uniswap V3 hold $41.7 million and $20.9 million, respectively. Together, the three protocols account for 63% of total tokenized stock DeFi TVL, which is about $192.6 million.

title: Tokenized Stock TVL on Uniswap V4 Reaches $59.1 Million
